messages:
Eli (Product): Quick design review for Error Insights / trace viewer. Goal: make correlation IDs and exports painless for support, and tighten a11y nits before alpha.
Maya (Design): Uploaded frames: https://www.figma.com/file/qwerty/error-insights-v1. Proposal: left column stack list, right column timeline+payload. Correlation ID pill in sticky header.
Owen (Frontend): split layout seems best. Implementation notes: lazy-load frame payloads on expand to avoid big initial payloads.
Sana (Backend): agreed on lazy loads. Also exports must be async. Do not return giant JSON in request. We'll provide an export job -> signed URL.
Jules (A11y): Accessibility notes: correlation pill must be a real button (aria-label="Copy correlation id"). Focus ring visible, keyboard can open history and copy.
Maya (Design): For export UI I'm showing a primary Export button + caret for JSON/HAR. If user toggles "include payloads" we show a mandatory PII confirm checkbox. Thoughts on wording?
Eli (Product): Microcopy: PII checkbox label: "I confirm I have authorization to export sensitive payloads." Link to policy: /policy/export. Warning text: "Exports may contain customer data."
Owen (Frontend): Copy action should show an accessible toast (role=status) saying "Correlation ID copied" and emit analytics event trace.copy_id. Also debounce export clicks client-side.
Sana (Backend): Server rules: POST /traces/{id}/export -> 202 {"export_id":"ex_01"}. Worker streams to object store. If include_payloads && !has_perm -> 403. Org-level concurrent exports = 2.
Jules (A11y): Modal accessibility: trap focus, aria-modal, aria-labelledby. PII checkbox must have aria-describedby pointing to the explainer. Export button disabled until checkbox checked.
Maya (Design): UX question: surface correlation history inline or flyout? Support needs quick access to related requests but keep header tidy.
Owen (Frontend): Flyout OK, but allow quick keyboard nav to previous IDs. Also provide small timestamps in history.
Sana (Backend): We can return related_ids in /traces/{id}?related=true. Keep related list capped at 25 and include a cursor for more.
Eli (Product): Decisions: split pane on desktop, overlay on mobile, sticky correlation pill with copy+history flyout, export async with mandatory opt-in for payloads + PII confirm, accessibility fixes listed. Owners: Maya (design), Owen (frontend), Sana (backend), Jules (a11y).
infra-bot: Deploy queued: error-insights-v1 -> staging at 2026-06-10T22:00Z :rocket:
Maya (Design): I'll push updated Figma with microcopy and contrast fixes today. Ping me for quick edits.
Owen (Frontend): I'll prototype keyboard copy + accessible toast and client debounce.
Sana (Backend): I'll add export job + signed-url + permission check. Also will include audit log entries for export events.
Jules (A11y): I'll run a keyboard/screen-reader pass after the design update. Small follow-up: ensure file badges hit 4.5:1 at small text sizes.
Eli (Product): Thanks all, this gives a clear checklist for alpha.
